    // The point on the surface nearest the query, by one Newton step along the
    // gradient.
    ProjectToSurface(self: IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
        => point - self.GradientAt(point).Normalize * self.Eval(point);

    //==
    // # SDF modifier application
    //
    // The parameter records declared in `implicit-sdf.types.plato`, applied to
    // a source field. Value modifiers reshape an already-sampled distance; domain
    // modifiers reshape the position BEFORE the source is sampled, so they compose
    // with `MapDomain`.
    //
    // A domain modifier keeps the source's fidelity only while the map it applies
    // does not STRETCH: rounding, shells, onions and elongation preserve exact
    // distances, but repetition, twist, bend and displacement can all report MORE
    // than the true distance, which is not a bound at all
    // (`implicit-sdf.concepts.plato`) and tunnels a sphere tracer. Each says below
    // what makes it safe again.

    // The rounded distance: subtracting the radius inflates the shape and rounds
    // its edges. Exact when the source distance is. (IQ: opRound.)
    ApplyToDistance(self: SdfRoundingModifier, distance: Number): Number
        => distance - self.Radius;

    // The shell distance: the region within half of Thickness on either side of
    // the source surface. Exact when the source distance is.
    // (IQ: opOnion, single layer.)
    ApplyToDistance(self: SdfShellModifier, distance: Number): Number
        => distance.Abs - self.Thickness * 0.5;

    // The distance to the outermost of the concentric shells. Repeat this with the
    // distance it returns to peel the next layer; Count layers reach TotalDepth.
    // Exact when the source distance is.
    ApplyToDistance(self: SdfOnionModifier, distance: Number): Number
        => distance.Abs - self.Thickness;

    // How far the full onion reaches inward from the source surface: one thickness
    // per shell.
    TotalDepth(self: SdfOnionModifier): Number
        => self.Thickness * self.Count.ToNumber;

    // The displaced distance: the source distance offset by the sampled scalar
    // field value scaled by Amplitude. NOT a bound: the displacement adds to the
    // distance as readily as it subtracts, so the result can EXCEED the true
    // distance to the displaced surface and a sphere tracer stepping by it tunnels.
    // Dividing by one plus Amplitude times the displacement field's Lipschitz
    // constant recovers a lower bound. (IQ: opDisplace.)
    ApplyToDistance(self: SdfDisplacementModifier3D, distance: Number, sourceValue: Number): Number
        => distance + self.Amplitude * sourceValue;

    // The position of this modifier's displacement field in the caller-supplied
    // list of spatial scalar fields.
    SourceFieldIndex(self: SdfDisplacementModifier3D): Integer
        => self.Source.Value;

    // The folded position for an elongated planar shape: the source is sampled at
    // the position pulled back toward the origin by up to Amount on each axis,
    // which inserts a straight section of that extent. The pull-back is a
    // translation, so this is exact when the source is. (IQ: opElongate.)
    ApplyToDomain(self: SdfElongationModifier2D, point: Point2D): Point2D
        => (
            point.X - point.X.Clamp(self.Amount.X.Negative, self.Amount.X),
            point.Y - point.Y.Clamp(self.Amount.Y.Negative, self.Amount.Y));

    // The folded position for an elongated spatial shape. Exact when the source
    // is. (IQ: opElongate.)
    ApplyToDomain(self: SdfElongationModifier3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
        => (
            point.X - point.X.Clamp(self.Amount.X.Negative, self.Amount.X),
            point.Y - point.Y.Clamp(self.Amount.Y.Negative, self.Amount.Y),
            point.Z - point.Z.Clamp(self.Amount.Z.Negative, self.Amount.Z));

    // One coordinate folded into its lattice cell, centred on the cell: the
    // coordinate minus the nearest whole multiple of period. Repetition is limited
    // to count cells on either side of the origin; a non-positive count repeats
    // without limit. Precondition: period is positive. (IQ: opRepetition/opRepLim.)
    RepeatedCoordinate(coordinate: Number, period: Number, count: Integer): Number {
        var cell = (coordinate / period + 0.5).Floor;
        var limit = count.ToNumber;
        var bounded = count > 0 ? cell.Clamp(limit.Negative, limit) : cell;
        return coordinate - period * bounded;
    }

    // The position within its lattice cell for a planar tiling: the source is
    // sampled once per cell of the given period, bounded by Counts per axis.
    // Exact when the source is AND it fits inside one cell, so that a point's
    // nearest copy is always the one in its own cell; otherwise NOT a bound —
    // the value is the distance to the own-cell copy, which can exceed the
    // distance to a neighbour's.
    ApplyToDomain(self: SdfRepetitionModifier2D, point: Point2D): Point2D
        => (
            RepeatedCoordinate(point.X, self.Period.X, self.Counts.X),
            RepeatedCoordinate(point.Y, self.Period.Y, self.Counts.Y));

    // The position within its lattice cell for a spatial tiling, bounded by Counts.
    // Same fidelity as the planar form: exact while the source fits in one cell,
    // not a bound once it does not.
    ApplyToDomain(self: SdfRepetitionModifier3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
        => (
            RepeatedCoordinate(point.X, self.Period.X, self.Counts.X),
            RepeatedCoordinate(point.Y, self.Period.Y, self.Counts.Y),
            RepeatedCoordinate(point.Z, self.Period.Z, self.Counts.Z));

    // The half-extent of a bounded planar tiling: the distance from the origin to
    // the outer face of the last repeated cell on each axis. Meaningless on an
    // axis whose count is non-positive (that axis repeats without limit).
    RepetitionExtent(self: SdfRepetitionModifier2D): Vector2D
        => (
            self.Period.X * self.Counts.X.ToNumber,
            self.Period.Y * self.Counts.Y.ToNumber);

    // The half-extent of a bounded spatial tiling; see the planar form.
    RepetitionExtent(self: SdfRepetitionModifier3D): Vector3D
        => (
            self.Period.X * self.Counts.X.ToNumber,
            self.Period.Y * self.Counts.Y.ToNumber,
            self.Period.Z * self.Counts.Z.ToNumber);

    // The point rotated about the Z axis by the given angle: the XY components
    // turn, Z is unchanged. Shared by the twist and bend domain modifiers.
    RotatedAboutZ(point: Point3D, angle: Angle): Point3D
        => (
            point.X * angle.Cos - point.Y * angle.Sin,
            point.X * angle.Sin + point.Y * angle.Cos,
            point.Z);

    // The untwisted position for a shape twisted about the Z axis: each slice is
    // rotated back by AnglePerUnit times its height before the source is sampled.
    // NOT a bound: the untwisting map stretches by sqrt(1 + (AnglePerUnit *
    // radius)^2), so the sampled distance can EXCEED the true distance to the
    // twisted shape and a sphere tracer stepping by it tunnels. Dividing by that
    // factor over the radius reached recovers a lower bound. (IQ: opTwist.)
    ApplyToDomain(self: SdfTwistModifier3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
        => RotatedAboutZ(point, self.AnglePerUnit * point.Z);

    // The unbent position for a shape bent about the Y axis: the turn accumulates
    // with distance along X at the given curvature. NOT a bound, for the same
    // reason as the twist: the unbending map stretches by sqrt(1 + (Curvature *
    // radius)^2), so the result can EXCEED the true distance and tunnels a sphere
    // tracer until divided by that factor. (IQ: opCheapBend.)
    ApplyToDomain(self: SdfBendModifier3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
        => RotatedAboutZ(point, (self.Curvature * point.X).Angle);

    //==
    // # Distance operators
    //
    // Pointwise CSG on already-sampled distances: the scalar kernels the field
    // combinators in `fields-implicits.library.plato` are written in terms
    // of, usable directly inside a hand-written distance function without
    // allocating a field.
    //
    // Each fidelity claim below (`implicit-sdf.concepts.plato`) is stated for
    // exact operands; feed it a lower bound and the result is a lower bound, feed
    // it something that is not a bound and neither is the result.

    // The union of two sampled distances: the minimum. Exact.
    UnionDistance(a: Number, b: Number): Number
        => a.Min(b);
